title: FishingLoot
description: FishingLoot adds a configurable fishing mini-game, golden zone bonuses, and multilingual support for servers.
body:
# FishingLoot

FishingLoot is a plugin that upgrades vanilla fishing with a more interactive and rewarding system.

Instead of relying only on luck, players can take part in a fishing mini-game, aim for golden zone bonuses, and enjoy a more engaging fishing experience. The plugin also includes configurable general loot settings and multilingual support for different server communities.

## Main Features

- Interactive fishing mini-game
- Golden zone bonus system
- Configurable general loot behavior
- Multilingual support
- Simple configuration
  
## Commands

- `/fishingloot` — Opens the main loot GUI
- `/fishingloot reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration
- `/fishingloot normalize` — Normalizes all loot chances so the total becomes 100
- `/fishingloot list` — Shows all loot entries and their chances
- `/fishingloot add <chance> <material> [min] [max] [randomEnchant]` — Adds a new vanilla material loot entry
- `/fishingloot remove <index>` — Removes a loot entry by index
- `/fishingloot setchance <index> <chance>` — Changes the chance of a loot entry
- `/fishingloot unique` — Opens the unique loot GUI
- `/fishingloot goldenbook <player>` — Gives the Golden Book item to a player

## Supported Platform

- **Paper**
- **Minecraft 1.21.x**

## Configuration

The plugin can be customized through its config files, allowing server owners to balance the fishing experience for their own server.

## Perfect For

- Survival servers
- Economy servers
- RPG servers
- Servers that want more interesting fishing mechanics
